WITH district_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    a.district_id,
    COUNT(*) as account_count,
    d.A3 as region
  FROM account a
  INNER JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY a.district_id, d.A3
),
region_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    dc.district_id,
    dc.account_count,
    dc.region,
    AVG(dc.account_count) OVER (PARTITION BY dc.region) as region_avg
  FROM district_counts dc
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT 
    rs.district_id,
    rs.region,
    rs.account_count,
    rs.account_count - rs.region_avg as exceeds_by
  FROM region_stats rs
  WHERE rs.account_count > rs.region_avg
)
SELECT 
  aa.district_id,
  aa.region,
  aa.account_count,
  aa.exceeds_by,
  aa.account_count / AVG(aa.account_count) OVER () as ratio
FROM above_average aa
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The ratio denominator is the average account count across all districts that are above their region's average (not the global average across all districts)
